documentQualityDecisions.rationale: Listed file item remains accurate after removing link-count and file-type fields.
Directory-listing entries accurately summarizes the remaining directory and file arrays; removed special-file arrays do not make it stale.
Information included in a listing accurately describes the remaining timestamps, ETag, attributes and permission-key options.
Listed directory item remains accurate after removing linkCount.
File properties accurately summarizes the remaining size, time and ETag fields without promising removed NFS ownership fields.
NFS file type still accurately describes Regular, Directory and SymLink after removing other variants.
